prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Irene, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Irene trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard from a contact at the municipal council that the pool is staying closed all summer due to serious contamination issues. It doesn't surprise me at all given how poorly they’ve maintained that place for years."
text: I just heard from my direct source at the council that the pool is officially condemned for the entire summer due to a massive, toxic contamination crisis. It was only a matter of time before their complete negligence finally destroyed the facility for good.
